rationale: All four premises hold against the patch: the delegation chain is as stated, tabulate adds every value (the removed NaN guard), Frequency.getMode is generic. The agent's chain names FastMath.tabulate as where NaNs enter the table, yet ranks StatUtils.mode first solely because its javadoc defines the NaN-ignored contract; mode is a one-line delegation that cannot produce the NaN, and intermediate docs are silent on NaN, so the convention-defining hop was blamed over the violating hop. Rank 1 is also the test's direct callee/facade. Partly defensible: the contract is documented only at mode, but the shared tabulation loop dropped the guard and fixing it covers both overloads. View excerpts are cut before tabulate's body and mode's javadoc.
